snippet.title: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN | Cast & Story Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
STRANGER THAN HEAVEN is RGG Studio's brand-new action-adventure game coming this winter to Xbox Game Pass, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, and Xbox Cloud as a Play Anywhere title.
